scope: Focused comparison of six populated repositories at pinned commits. Trees enumerated without truncation; selected documents retrieved. This is not a semantic audit of every repository file or a proof of historical absence.

heads.message:
Audit deferred reasoning, placeholders, and performativity across four repositories

Preserve exact occurrence inventories, executed acceptance counterexamples, completed missing deductions, and the integrated philosophy. Distinguish repaired historical defects, legitimate procedures and abstractions, and surviving failures at the pinned audit cutoff.

Preserve concurrent catalogs, inquiries, findings, and all original research credit. Include the complete audit in the verified checkpoint.
Make beneficial mind-change selection the default model-operated process
Use shared mind-change standards to select and arrange contributions by default

Derive the minimum representation that preserves answers through action

Present availability merges protected access, revocable permission, and authority awaiting activation. Derive which distinctions must survive for exact updates through every finite sequence of given deterministic actions, and show why single-action comparisons miss the finalization-then-veto distinction.

Construct the minimum representation, prove termination of finite partition refinement, and identify the irrelevant pass-color distinction that can be removed. Integrate the result into the subject catalog, derivation relations, translations, and reading order. Replace two definitions that referred to an absent Intelligence entry with explicit local definitions and record their adaptation.

Verification: independently searched decoders and updaters across all 5 partitions of every 3-state, 2-action, binary-answer system (5,832 systems); checked the concrete access model and empty-action/question boundaries. All 23 revised construction checks and 23 structural/textual checks pass. All 43 uploaded files match the reviewed local bytes.

Record the integration status and correct the not-in-repo list

  reasoningtool2 carried, and the answer to this brief's open question 2 —
  643 of 656 skills (98%) land on the 23 verbs, so the table is the index,
  with the crowding (search 166, check 99) against the near-empty act and

perspective_and_mind_change_review.scope: Five public sources inspected for specific passages and relevant qualifications. The critique does not claim an exhaustive review of INCOSE, SEBoK, their references, or systems engineering practice.

sources.title: What is Systems Thinking?
sections: Systems Thinking and the Systems Approach
sources.use: Observer-dependent boundaries; broad social and philosophical scope; whole/partial understanding; adequacy left partly to judgment.

sources.title: Principles of Systems Thinking
sources.use: Selection instructions, consistency, dualities, and explicit qualification of principle applicability.

sources.title: Systems Engineering Overview
sections: Scope of Systems Engineering within the Engineered Systems Domain
sources.use: Professional scope and the acknowledged dependency on execution outside that scope.

sources.title: Guidance for Engineers
sources.use: Professional reading organization and a concrete intended audience; not a universal limit on method applicability.

sources.title: Digital Transformation using MBSE: Notes from the field
sources.author: William Donaldson
sources.source_type: Invited webinar presentation; not treated as an institutional standard
sources.use: Explicit treatment of mind change and beneficial change; adoption and compliance as proposed destinations; attribution of the six-step sequence preserved.

perspective_and_mind_change_review.standing: Source descriptions identify the inspected passages. Counterexamples and replacements are authored deductions using stipulated examples or identified prior results. No measured recipient benefit or field-wide superiority is asserted.

source.title: Near Optimal Bayesian Active Learning for Decision Making
source.use: Credit for decision-region inquiry with overlapping adequate-action regions. The paper develops a Bayesian expected-test-cost approach; the local construction uses exact worst-case inquiry plus intervention cost.

contribution_choice_review.local_contribution: Completed finite optimization, feasibility obstruction, independently checked implementation, executed toy repairs, and integrated corrections. No novelty claim for decision-directed inquiry or dynamic programming.
